introduction: The University of Engineering and Technology (UET) is one of Pakistan's premier institutions for higher education in engineering, technology, and applied sciences. Established with a vision to advance technical knowledge and innovation, UET has campuses across the country, offering a diverse range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs. Known for its rigorous academic standards, state-of-the-art facilities, and highly qualified faculty, UET plays a pivotal role in shaping future engineers and technologists.

computer_science.program_description: The Bachelor of Science in Computer Science is a professional degree program aimed at producing graduates for the job market as software engineers, entrepreneurs, IT consultants, and academic professionals. This program is tailored to introduce, develop, and ingrain the understanding of computing discipline in students.

admission_criteria.criteria: 12 Year of Education, Intermediate (HSSC) examination, FSc (Pre-Engineering)/ ICS/ I.Com, A-Level, DAE(computer) with Mathematics and minimum 50% marks or equivalent qualification with Mathematics certified by IBCC.

Students having FSc (Pre-Medical) with minimum 50% marks are also eligible for admission but according to National Computing Education Accreditation Council (NCEAC) of HEC such students must pass deficiency courses of Mathematics of 6 credit hours within one year.

software_engineering.program_description: Software plays a central and underpinning role in almost all aspects of daily life: communications, government, manufacturing, banking and finance, education, transportation, entertainment, medicine, agriculture, and law. Software Engineering is the application of a systematic, disciplined and quantifiable approach to the design, development, operation, and maintenance of software systems.

admission_criteria.criteria: Minimum 60% marks in Intermediate/12 years schooling/A- Level (HSSC) or Equivalent with Mathematics are required for admission in BS (Software Engineering).

artificial_intelligence.program_description: The Bachelor of Science (BS) in Artificial Intelligence (AI) program. In this dynamic and interdisciplinary field, students embark on a journey to explore the realms of cutting-edge technology, innovation, and problem-solving. AI is revolutionizing industries, from manufacturing to healthcare, and reshaping the way we interact with technology and the world around us.

admission_criteria.criteria: 12 Years education F.Sc. (Pre-engineering, Pre-medical) or ICS (with Math) or DAE in relevant field or F.A (IT) or Equivalent with Minimum 45% Marks. Students with minimum 45% marks in F.Sc (PreMedical)/FA (IT) must complete a deficiency course in Mathematics.

biomedical_engineering.program_description: The aim of Bachelor of Science in Biomedical Engineering program is to produce graduates in the country. The graduates will be competent to identify, assess, evaluate, manage and trouble shoot all the problems and errors in biomedical equipment and are eligible enough to get hands on the biomedical equipment and machines to maintain and to repair them.

admission_criteria.criteria: 50% marks in F.Sc. (Pre-Engineering), ICS (Math, phy.) / D.A.E (Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Telecommunication, Computer Technology) / A-Level or Equivalent

data_science.program_description: The department introduced a 4-year BS Data Science program in 2024. It offers specializations in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine learning, Big Data or Cybersecurity.

admission_criteria.criteria: FSc (Pre-Medical)/Grade 12/High School Certificate/Equivalent with a minimum of 60% marks.

electrical_engineering.program_description: The department has been accorded level II accreditation (substantially equivalent to Washington accord) by PEC with effect from Batch-2016. The undergraduate Electrical Engineering program is based on solid foundation in Mathematics, Natural Sciences, Computer programming and core engineering knowledge to ensure successful completion of the program and to equip the students with future professional growth, rational reasoning and analysis.

admission_criteria.criteria: At least 60% marks in F.Sc. Pre-Engineering/ICS with (Maths, Physics & Computer Science/Studies) A levels with (Maths, Physics & Chemistry)/DAE in Electrical/Electronic Technology or equivalent.

mechanical_engineering.program_description: Mechanical Engineering is one of the oldest, and broadest engineering discipline, which is concerned with the utilization of principles of Energy, Mechanics, and Materials Sciences for the analysis, design, and manufacturing of a variety of mechanical systems including but not limited to Power Plants, Fluid Machinery, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Systems, Mechanisms and Machinery, Pipelines, Transportation Systems of all kinds.

admission_criteria.criteria: 12 years of Education, F.Sc. (Pre-Engineering), ICS (Math, phy.), D.A.E. (Mechanical, Auto & Diesel, HVAC), A-Level or Equivalent with minimum 50% marks.

civil_engineering.program_description: The main emphasis of the Civil Engineering program is to provide the students with a sound foundation of mathematics and other sciences to utilize their knowledge in solving problems of structure, irrigation and hydraulics, soil mechanics, foundations, highways transportation, and environmental engineering.

admission_criteria.criteria: 12 years of Education, F.Sc. (Pre-Engineering), ICS (Math, phy.), D.A.E. (Civil/Architecture/Mining), A-Level or Equivalent with minimum 50% marks.
